## Whapi Classification

**Whapi is an unofficial WhatsApp API gateway**, not an official Meta Cloud API product. According to the content: "WhatsApp API gateways provide API access to a regular WhatsApp account and are not officially approved by Meta."

**Number Type & Pairing:**
- Uses regular/personal WhatsApp accounts
- Connection method: "scan a QR code (or use an authorization code), and the account is connected within seconds"
- No business verification required
- Chat history preserved during setup

**Pricing Model:**
- "Subscription-based (no Meta per-message fees)"

**Risk Profile:**
- "Higher operational and policy risk"

The guide notes these require: business verification via Facebook Business Manager, number registration, template approval, and formal onboarding—typically slower than Whapi's QR-code approach.

**Meta Cloud API:**
Offers direct Meta billing at lower cost than BSPs but maintains identical policy restrictions and requires handling infrastructure independently.

## Feature Accessibility

Whapi uniquely supports: groups, channels, communities, statuses, catalogs, and native WhatsApp features. Official APIs significantly restrict these capabilities.

Yes. The WhatsApp API plans charge "€49 per number per month" (Regular), "€99 per number per month" (Premium), or "€249 per number per month" (High Throughput), plus Meta messaging fees separately.

# WhatsApp BSP / API Wrapper Research — July 2026

## Twilio WhatsApp API
- **(a)** Official — reseller/BSP on top of Meta's official WhatsApp Business (Cloud) API.
- **(b)** Number: **dedicated Cloud-API sender**, not the owner's personal WhatsApp. Provisions/registers a business number; personal chat history not usable.
- **(c)** Onboarding: free **Sandbox** for instant testing — join a shared Twilio test number by sending a keyword; live in minutes with $15 trial credit. Production = Facebook Business Manager verification + number registration + template approval (days).
- **(d)** Cost: **$0.005/message (in or out)** on top of Meta's per-template fee (~$0.0034–$0.0499, varies by category: utility/auth/marketing). 2026 note: Meta retired conversation-based billing for business-initiated traffic → now per-template; customer-service-window replies still free. Volume discounts in 2026 for Utility/Auth only (marketing excluded). No flat platform fee — pure per-message.
- **(e)** Speed to pilot: **Sandbox = minutes today**; real branded number = days (Meta verification + template approval).

## 360dialog
- **(a)** Official BSP — direct **Cloud API** access, pure API, no inbox/CRM/AI/template-builder (build your own UI on top).
- **(b)** Number: **dedicated official Cloud API business number** ("you own your WhatsApp number forever"), not personal WhatsApp.
- **(c)** Onboarding: managed BSP onboarding via Meta (business verification). Support SLA <4h (Regular) / <30min (Premium).
- **(d)** Cost: **flat monthly per number — €49 (Regular) / €99 (Premium) / €249 (High Throughput)**, plus Meta messaging fees passed through **at cost with zero markup** (its key differentiator vs Twilio's +$0.005/msg and WATI's ~20% markup). Most transparent BSP.
- **(e)** Speed to pilot: slower than unofficial — days for Meta verification/number provisioning, but cheapest at scale once live.

## WATI
- **(a)** Official — no-code SaaS layer on top of the official WhatsApp Business API.
- **(b)** Number: **dedicated official business number**, not personal WhatsApp.
- **(c)** Onboarding: guided SaaS signup + Meta verification; ships a **no-code shared team inbox, broadcast campaigns, and chatbot/workflow builder** out of the box.
- **(d)** Cost (billed annually): **Growth $59/mo** (5 users, 1,000 conversations), **Pro $119/mo** (advanced chatbots, forms, retargeting, AI), **Business $279/mo** (multi-number, round-robin, CSM). Extra seats ~$24 (Pro) / ~$69 (Business). **Plus ~20% markup on Meta message rates** and add-on fees. Up to 25% off + free onboarding on annual.
- **(e)** Speed to pilot: fast for a non-developer (no-code inbox/bot usable immediately after verification), but still gated by Meta number verification. **Target market: SMBs / non-technical teams** wanting a ready-made inbox + bot without building UI.

## Whapi.cloud
- **(a)** **UNOFFICIAL** — hosted API-as-a-service wrapping the WhatsApp Web session protocol (same mechanism as Baileys, but hosted). **Not endorsed by Meta.**
- **(b)** **Yes — uses a regular/personal WhatsApp number.** No Meta business verification. Chat history preserved on connect.
- **(c)** Pairing: **scan a QR code (or pairing/authorization code)** — number linked in seconds. Can re-link a different number later.
- **(d)** Cost: **flat $29/mo per connected number, nothing per message.** Free sandbox tier (150 msg/day, 5 active conversations/month).
- **(e)** Speed to pilot: **fastest — minutes today** (QR scan, no verification). **Full native feature access: groups, channels, communities, status, catalogs** (official APIs restrict these).
- **⚠️ Ban risk:** unofficial = real risk of soft bans / account restrictions (usually recoverable). Mitigate by warming new numbers slowly, messaging only opt-ins, avoiding bulk blasts from fresh numbers. No Meta template pre-moderation.

## Quick comparison
| | Official? | Owner's personal # | Pairing | Rough cost | Pilot today |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Twilio | Yes (Cloud API) | No (dedicated) | Sandbox keyword / Meta verify | $0.005/msg + Meta fee | Sandbox: minutes; prod: days |
| 360dialog | Yes (Cloud API) | No (dedicated) | Meta BSP onboarding | €49–249/mo flat + Meta at cost | Days |
| WATI | Yes (SaaS on API) | No (dedicated) | SaaS + Meta verify | $59–279/mo + ~20% msg markup | Fast (no-code) after verify |
| Whapi.cloud | **No (unofficial)** | **Yes** | **QR / pairing code** | $29/mo per number, flat | **Minutes** |

**Bottom line for your case:** if you need the **owner's own personal number**, group support, and a live pilot in minutes with zero Meta verification, **Whapi.cloud** is the only fit — at the cost of ban risk. For a compliant dedicated-number path, **Twilio sandbox** is fastest to test and **360dialog** is cheapest at scale (flat fee, no markup); **WATI** if you want a ready-made no-code inbox/bot instead of building UI.
